nodes.label: Five-axis code review (correctness, security, tests, architecture, scope)
Rationale: wrong assumption costs more than short escalation
Rationale: stale runs drop WIP accounting, auto-escalate, lose merge-queue spot, marked dead by CoS
Rationale: team invocation fan-out is L1 orchestration work
Rationale: after compaction conversation context is gone, memory carries knowledge forward
Rationale: skipping recall reinvents wheels or contradicts prior decisions
Rationale: workflows give retries, state persistence, telemetry, resumability
Rationale: unclosed run blocks WIP and confuses next agent
Rationale: no run_id makes heartbeat/recall/completion inert
Rationale: control plane must know agent exists — WIP limiter and CoS context builder read agent_runs
Rationale: workspace status avoids duplicate work, WIP surprises, stale context
Rationale: subagent cannot pollute memory tree with own files/decisions
